question: Why must meat and wine never be used without the prescribed method?
premises: Previous verses condemn killing and consumption without method.
Meat and wine are named as substances of concern.
Their use without method is prohibited in any circumstance.
inference: Because of the faults of non-methodical killing and consumption, meat and wine must never be used without method.
plain_english: Therefore, one should never use meat or wine without the prescribed method.
